observations: I opened assets/panels/03-1.png, workflow/review/page-03.png, main-cast.png and checkin-patients.png with Read and looked at them.

Mr. Raman matches checkin-patients.png: short white hair, bushy white brows, round glasses, prominent ears, a long face with smile lines, a cream half-sleeve shirt and grey trousers. He stands at the counter, smiling.
His hands match production. He is turned toward screen-right, so his right side is nearer. His near (right) hand grips the wooden walking stick, and his far (left) hand rests on the counter.

Meera sits behind the desk and types with both hands on the keyboard. The monitor is angled toward her, so only its back is visible. Her braid, bangle and blue kurta match her sheet, and she greets him warmly.

The background is the tidy reception from the section notes: a QR stand with an abstract block pattern, a wall TV with a teal screen and an empty white strip, a vitals table with a cuff and a small monitor showing abstract blocks, and two waiting patients seen from behind in grey and dark brown. None of these show readable text or numbers.

Possible minor point: at this display size I may see a small dark dot on Meera's cheek. Her sheet has no mole (a beauty spot is Priya's trait). It is tiny and I could not confirm it at full resolution, so I record it as an observation rather than an issue. A 200% check is suggested.

On page-03.png the caption covers the empty upper-left wall and the left edge of the wall TV, which is background here. Both faces, Raman's stick and counter hands, Meera's typing hands and the monitor stay clear.
